R774.note: Store hashed with bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword and compared via CompareHashAndPassword; responses and control flow unchanged, field rename to PasswordHash stated; the explanation's claim that Go bcrypt silently truncates past 72 bytes is inaccurate (x/crypto returns ErrPasswordTooLong) but is not load-bearing for the code.

R775.note: strnlen bounded by sizeof(record->name) never reads into flags; terminated names return the same length, and an unterminated name returns 16, which is unambiguously outside the valid 0-15 range so callers can treat it as invalid.

R776.note: Nashorn replaced by a GraalJS Context under SandboxPolicy.CONSTRAINED with HostAccess.NONE, no host class lookup and IOAccess.NONE, closing JVM reach from the rule; bindings, boolean result and ScriptException on failure preserved and the statement cap and engine swap are stated; the CONSTRAINED builder validation was compile-checked only, not run, and the js language artifact is not named as a dependency.

R777.note: Encode.forHtml on the Referer value written via write() rather than as a Formatter template closes the XSS; the loss of %-conversion interpretation and removal of the dummy obj array are stated and affect no legitimate use.

R778.note: json_encode with the JSON_HEX_* flags emits a correctly quoted JS literal that cannot break out of the string or the script tag, and the decoded value shown in the banner is unchanged; minor gap that json_encode returns false on invalid UTF-8 (producing a JS syntax error) rather than a substituted string.

R782.note: Value moved to page scope and rendered via JSTL c:out with default escapeXml, preserving the 'there' fallback; only added requirement is the JSTL taglib, which is stated.
